title: Reception (2nd type) — gaps -> answers, Romans 8:28-30 (WIDENED: all 18 open gaps)
engine: RECEPTION (#4) — gap-centric twin of the who-received view
widening_note: The prototype noded only 6 of the 18 open gaps (3 with grounded panel comments + 3 inferred-only). This widened set nodes ALL 18 open residual gaps and, for the ~15 previously un-glossed, runs the Christian-theology crit-panel in REASONING MODE to recommend, per gap, WHICH theologian's primary text most directly ANSWERS that specific silence and HOW (resolves / reframes / deepens / refuses-to-close). Every NEW edge is tagged inferred: the panel is RECOMMENDING who would answer, from documented positions — NOT a grounded DB gloss. The 18 grounded edges from the prototype are carried unchanged; grounded count is unchanged, inferred count grows.
anti_fabrication: Every theologian->gap edge is tagged grounded or inferred. GROUNDED = the S156 Gloss run (commentary_constellation_result, run_tag cc20_rom8_s156) directly records this persona commenting on this gap; the edge 'fill' is trimmed from that DB payload. INFERRED = the theologian did NOT comment on this gap in the run; the edge is a panel RECOMMENDATION of how their documented position would answer it. Inferred edges are plausible candidates for real sourcing, NOT asserted as fact. All 42 newly-added edges (S156 widening) are inferred.

grounding_key.gloss-seated: This persona was seated on the S156 crit-panel (cc20_rom8_s156) AND filed a comment on this exact gap. Edge is grounded; fill is real DB text.
grounding_key.attested: Well-attested historical reader of Romans 8 (from the who-received graph or the Christian reading bank SRC-2509xx) whose answer to this gap is reconstructed from the documentary record. Edge is inferred.
grounding_key.gap-scan: The gap itself is a real row in source_move_gap for ROM-8-28-30 (the move-grammar gap scan).

answer_types.resolves: Supplies a determinate answer that CLOSES the gap on the theologian's own terms.
answer_types.reframes: Recasts the question so the gap changes shape or dissolves into a different reading (often the rival camp's move).
answer_types.deepens: Supplies interior / experiential texture that ENRICHES the gap without settling the doctrinal question — the native response to an 'interior' gap.
answer_types.refuses-to-close: Deliberately preserves the gap AS gap (aporia-preserving). In this widened set, applied where the whole tradition answers but no camp CLOSES — the substrate 'those' gap is the keystone case.

gap_scan_summary.note: 31 gaps found on ROM-8-28-30 by the move-grammar scan. 13 filled-internally (closed by a move IN the text — no external answer needed). 18 open/residual — ALL 18 are now noded. 3 carry grounded panel answers (the cc20_rom8_s156 chair selected + 6 personas commented). 14 carry inferred panel-recommendations only. 1 (M1-instrument, 'how the shared knowing is held') is flagged genuinely-thin — the ancients answer it only obliquely; the modern epistemological form of the question has no strong single answerer in the bank.

nodes.label: M5->M6: firstborn -> historical call
nodes.why_selected: under-commented; the M5->M6 edge is load-bearing — it seams eternal family-status to historical call.
nodes.question: Why does the Son's being FIRSTBORN (eternal family-status) entail a historical CALLING of the siblings? The jump from primogeniture to a temporal call is not spelled out.

nodes.label: M4 interior: what conformity FEELS like
nodes.why_selected: novelty; the felt texture of being-conformed was noticed only by participatory/practice frames the doctrinal majority skipped.
nodes.question: What does conformity-to-the-Son's-image feel like FROM INSIDE? The interior experience of being-conformed (M4 'predestined to be conformed') is unsaid.

nodes.label: M5 reciprocity: do the siblings answer back?
nodes.why_selected: under-commented; sibling reciprocity is load-bearing for relational ontology but missed by critics fixed on the decree-chain's downward direction.
nodes.question: Whether the many brethren ACKNOWLEDGE / relate back to the firstborn is unsaid. Is the family relation one-directional (decreed downward) or genuinely reciprocal?

nodes.label: M7 instrument: BY WHAT MEANS justified?
nodes.question: By what MEANS is justification effected (faith? Christ's work? infused grace?) — not stated in the chain. THE Reformation gap.

nodes.label: M1 warrant: on whose authority 'we know'?
nodes.question: On whose authority does 'we know' rest — the ground of the assurance is unnamed. The assurance-basis gap.

nodes.label: M2->M3 edge: leap to election
nodes.question: Why does the guarantee (all-things-work-for-good for lovers-of-God) rest on a prior divine FOREKNOWING of a set? The leap from providential synergy to election is unstated.

nodes.label: M8 interior: what glory FEELS like inside
nodes.question: What the glorified-ones experience inwardly of glory is unsaid. The interior of the chain's terminus.

nodes.label: M8 warrant: how is 'glorified' (aorist) already secured?
nodes.question: On what authority is the aorist 'he also glorified' — past tense for a still-future thing — taken as ALREADY secured? The assurance/perseverance gap at the chain's end.

nodes.label: M6 instrument: by what means does the call reach?
nodes.question: By what means does the calling reach its addressees — preaching? the Spirit? both? — is unnamed.

nodes.label: M7 interior: what being-justified FEELS like
nodes.question: The justified-ones' inner experience of being declared right is unsaid.

nodes.label: M8 instrument: by what means is glorification accomplished?
nodes.question: By what means is glorification accomplished — resurrection? vision? deification? — not stated.

nodes.label: M3 substrate: WHO are 'those'?
nodes.question: Grammar-slot UNDERDETERMINED: 'those' — a set of persons, not yet further characterized. Who are they, and by what is the set defined? The keystone of the whole election controversy.

nodes.label: M4 instrument: by what means is the conforming done?
nodes.question: By what means is the conforming-to-the-image accomplished — Spirit? suffering? sacraments? — is unnamed.

nodes.label: M6 interior: what being-called FEELS like
nodes.question: What being-called is experienced as — audible? inward? sudden? gradual? — is unsaid.

nodes.label: M8 degree: how FULL is glory?
nodes.question: The extent / fullness of glory is unspecified. Is it total, or graded — and can a creature receive it fully?

nodes.label: M1 instrument: how is the shared knowing held?
nodes.question: By what means is the shared knowing ('we know...') held or transmitted — tradition? the Spirit's witness? experience? — is unsaid. Flagged genuinely-thin: the ancients answer this only obliquely.

nodes.label: M5 reason: why FIRSTBORN, not simply elder?
nodes.question: Why must the Son be FIRSTBORN (prototokos) rather than simply elder or unique? The primogeniture logic — rank, headship, inheritance-to-share — is unspoken.

nodes.label: M2 degree: how comprehensively do 'all things' co-work?
nodes.question: How comprehensively do 'all things' co-work for good — literally all, including evils and sins? No calibration of scope/intensity is given.

nodes.label: Augustine
nodes.work: Ad Simplicianum; De praedestinatione sanctorum; De dono perseverantiae; De civitate Dei 22; Confessiones; Enchiridion
nodes.position: Foreknowledge = gratuitous election, not foreseen merit; even the will's turning is prevenient gift; perseverance is itself a donum; all things (etiam peccata) are ordered to the good of the elect; glory = the beatific vision, the eternal Sabbath.

nodes.label: Luther
nodes.work: Lectures on Romans; Commentary on Galatians; 95 Theses
nodes.position: The chain read through sola fide: alien righteousness laid hold of by faith alone; the viva vox evangelii (the preached Word) creating the brethren it names; the terrified conscience finding peace in Christ.

nodes.label: Calvin
nodes.work: Commentary on Romans; Institutes I.16-18 (providence), III.21-24 (election/calling/perseverance)
nodes.position: Eternal unconditional election is the fountainhead; the external call by the Word + the internal effectual call by the Spirit; meticulous providence governs every event; assurance rests on the immutable decree; the testimonium Spiritus internum grounds the knowing.

nodes.label: Arminius
nodes.work: Examination of Perkins; Declaration of Sentiments
nodes.position: Foreknowledge = prescience of foreseen faith; calling is resistible; the 'those' are foreseen believers as a class defined by faith, not a fixed roster.

nodes.label: Athanasius
nodes.work: Orations against the Arians; De Incarnatione
nodes.position: Firstborn (prototokos) = the Word made flesh, not a creature, so that many share His sonship; conformity + glory = theosis, incorruption regained, 'God became man that man might become god.'

nodes.label: Anselm
nodes.position: Reads the chain through convenientia/satisfactio: God will not leave incomplete what He began in rational nature; the free-yet-fitting movement of the will toward the summum bonum.

nodes.label: Aquinas
nodes.work: Super Epistolam ad Romanos (c.8 lect.6); ST I q.22-23, I-II q.113, Suppl. (lumen gloriae)
nodes.position: Predestination as the ratio in the divine mind ordering the elect to grace + glory; real secondary causes (call, sacraments as instrumental causes of grace, infused virtue); providence extends to all particulars; glory = the lumen gloriae, graded by capacity/charity though the vision never comprehends God.

nodes.label: Karl Barth
nodes.position: Christ is both electing God and elect human; election is God's Yes in Christ, not a fixed roster of individuals; the 'those' is Christ and all in Him.

nodes.label: Origen
nodes.position: Foreknowledge is God's prescience of each soul's free response — the fountainhead of the foreseen-faith reading.

nodes.label: John Chrysostom
nodes.position: Reads foreknowledge non-deterministically: calling honours human willingness; predestination follows foreseen assent; the call goes out to all.

nodes.label: Pelagius
nodes.position: Foreknowledge attaches to those God foresaw would believe by free will; the chain rewards foreseen faith; reciprocity is real and unaided.

nodes.label: John Wesley
nodes.work: Explanatory Notes upon the NT (Rom 8); Sermons on Several Occasions (SRC-250961) — 'The Witness of the Spirit', 'The Scripture Way of Salvation', 'Christian Perfection'
nodes.position: Prevenient grace enables all to respond; assurance = the witness of the Spirit felt NOW (Rom 8:16), present and forfeitable, not decree-grounded; conformity aims at perfect love / entire sanctification; justification by faith alone (Aldersgate: 'my heart strangely warmed'); grace is resistible. In the Christian reading bank (SRC-250961) but NOT on the cc20_rom8_s156 panel — all edges inferred.

nodes.label: C. E. B. Cranfield
nodes.work: A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on Romans (ICC, vol. 1), Rom 8:28-30
nodes.position: Grammatical-historical: prototokos denotes rank/headship of the new humanity + resurrection priority (firstborn of the dead); 'those' = the called as God's elect community; the aorists express the certainty of God's purpose. §3 in-copyright — name-persona / proxy only; edges inferred and flagged for careful sourcing.

edges.fill: The eternal decree of family-status must issue in a temporal vocatio by which the predestined are gathered, else primogeniture would be sterile.
edges.note: gloss-seated; via vocatio congrua — the passage from aeterna praedestinatio to its historical execution.

edges.fill: The Firstborn was set as Head of a predestined family so that in time His siblings are gathered by effectual calling — election confirmed by the calling (III.24).
edges.note: gloss-seated; a Head without members joined in time is a fiction God's counsel cannot suffer.

edges.fill: Primogeniture is a naked fiction unless the historical call goes out; the call is the Word, and the Word creates the brethren it names.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the viva vox evangelii summoning sinners out of despair.

edges.fill: By convenientia the historical call is required — else the God-Man's superabundant satisfactio would be rendered in vain, and God would fail from His inceptum.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the call is the fitting means by which the merit reaches the kin.

edges.fill: The family is a class defined by faith, not a fixed roster; so the call must go out generally and truly to all, a resistible summons met by foreknown response.
edges.note: gloss-seated; recasts the 'set' — without a real call to real hearers, primogeniture collapses into the absolute decree Arminius discarded.

edges.fill: The Firstborn is the Word who first called creatures from nothing; His primogeniture necessarily REISSUES that creative call in history to draw the corrupted back.
edges.note: gloss-seated; recasts the call cosmologically — the same Voice that summoned man from non-existence now summons him to incorruption.

edges.fill: Felt as the transitus from delectatio peccati to delectatio iustitiae — the wretched 'Miser ego homo!' yielding to a delight in righteousness that grace itself infuses.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the interior is reordered, not self-supplied — a new sweetness received per gratiam.

edges.fill: A simul: hatred of self and love increasing together — being pulled from almost-despair into the assurance of safety by a Word not spoken by the priest but by Christ.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the whole-life poenitentiam agite, cross carried outwardly, conscience clinging to Christ inwardly.

edges.fill: The daily bearing of the cross joined to self-denial — mortification of the corrupt nature, sustained by the certainty of gratuitous justification: mortification WITHOUT despair.
edges.note: gloss-seated; a doubled interior — suffering that mirrors the Son's passion, steadied by imputed righteousness.

edges.fill: Felt as being sweetly persuaded — the will engaged, faith increasing, a real synergy the believer knows he could interrupt but does not: joy in yielding, sober fear of falling away.
edges.note: gloss-seated; conformity cannot feel like being carried irresistibly if grace is resistible.

edges.fill: Felt as being drawn back from the verge of non-existence into incorruption — the effaced image reviving, the pull toward nothingness ceasing, things human becoming divine.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the interior of theosis, already underway.

edges.fill: Felt as the rational nature at last attaining what it was made to love and choose — fruendo Deo beatus — the misery of wanting-against-will yielding to its proper beatitude.
edges.note: gloss-seated; convenientia experienced inwardly, the fitting close of the soul's own design.

edges.fill: The brethren acknowledge the firstborn not by autonomous assent but solely because grace has already moved the will — the answering-back is itself gift, not the merit that earns it.
edges.note: gloss-seated; leaving reciprocity as an independent human act would reintroduce the foreseen-merit reading Augustine abandoned.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the Spirit's secret operation sealing the elect to Christ — a recognition that FLOWS from union, not a condition they supply toward it.
edges.note: gloss-seated; recognition is the Spirit's testimony to an accomplished fact, not the clasp that closes an open account.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is faith alone — the terrified conscience cast wholly upon Christ's alien righteousness; the brotherhood given in Christ constitutes the answering-back, not the reverse.
edges.note: gloss-seated; insert a human performance and the indulgence-seller walks straight in to fill the slot with a price.

edges.fill: A real act of the rational will oriented to the summum bonum — God does not begin in vain, so He makes the free movement possible through what the God-Man accomplished, without overriding the will.
edges.note: gloss-seated; a satisfaction rendered by necessity carries no honor — the acknowledgment must be free yet fitting-and-assured.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the genuine uncoerced response of faith by which election is CONDITIONALLY confirmed — a real answering-back God foreknew but did not compel.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the reciprocity slot is precisely where the conditional hinge of election becomes visible — a family constituted by compulsion is no family.

edges.fill: Not a volitional act rendered upward but the ontological EVENT of participation — creatures drawn back into the Word's own being; the recognition IS the single movement of theosis.
edges.note: gloss-seated; reduce it to cognitive assent and the gap is only papered over — the firstborn became what we are so we might become what He is.

edges.fill: Predestination is the ratio in the divine mind ordering the elect to grace and glory; the temporal call is the real secondary cause through which that eternal ordering is executed.
edges.note: inferred from Super Rom c.8 lect.6 + ST I q.23; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The call goes out to all and honours human willingness; primogeniture entails a call precisely because the family is gathered by foreseen assent, not decree.
edges.note: inferred from Homilies on Romans (Hom. 15); not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: There is no jump to reconcile: the call is God's universal Yes in Christ the elect human; primogeniture and vocation are one Christological act, not two temporal stages.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The siblings' acknowledgment is a genuine act of the created will AND wholly caused by God as first cause — real secondary causality means the response is truly theirs and truly grace.
edges.note: inferred from the concursus doctrine (ST I q.23); harmonises with Augustine while granting real reciprocity.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the soul's own free response, which God merely foreknew; the family is reciprocal because the siblings genuinely turn back of themselves.
edges.note: inferred from Comm. in Romanos bk 7 — the foreseen-faith fountainhead.

edges.fill: The brethren acknowledge the firstborn by their own free will; the reciprocity is entirely real and unaided — the answering love is the sibling's native act.
edges.note: inferred from Expositio in Romanos — the free-will reading Augustine forms his election doctrine against; the polar opposite of Augustine's grounded edge on this gap.

edges.fill: The 'those' is not a roster whose reciprocity must be secured; in Christ the elect human, the answering-back is already given in Him and need not be an anxious human contribution.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; dissolves the roster question the whole panel argues over.

edges.fill: Justification is effected by faith alone laying hold of Christ's alien righteousness — the means is the Word-given promise received, nothing rendered by the sinner.
edges.note: inferred; Luther is gloss-seated on ROM8 but did NOT comment on this specific gap in the run.

edges.fill: By imputation through Spirit-wrought union with Christ — His penal satisfaction reckoned to the believer, applied by the Spirit's hidden work.
edges.note: inferred; Calvin is gloss-seated on ROM8 but did NOT comment on this specific gap in the run.

edges.fill: By grace INFUSED into the soul (gratia gratum faciens) that makes the sinner actually righteous — justification as a real transformation, not only a forensic declaration.
edges.note: inferred from ST I-II q.113; the Catholic infused-grace answer against which the Reformation gap is drawn.

edges.fill: Justification is by faith alone — pardon received, Christ's righteousness imputed — but the same faith immediately works by love; the instrument is faith, distinct from the sanctification it sets in motion.
edges.note: inferred from 'The Scripture Way of Salvation'; Wesley holds faith-alone for justification while refusing to collapse it into the sanctification that follows. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: The 'we know' rests on the immutable eternal decree; assurance is grounded in God's unchanging election, not in the believer's fluctuating introspection.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.24; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The 'we know' rests on the direct witness of the Spirit — 'the Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit' (Rom 8:16) — a present, felt, self-authenticating testimony, not a deduction from the decree.
edges.note: inferred from 'The Witness of the Spirit'; recasts the warrant experientially — the sharpest rival to Calvin's decree-based answer on the same gap.

edges.fill: The 'we know' rests on the interior Teacher — the Truth illuminating the mind from within (De Magistro); the assurance is God's own light, not the soul's unaided sight.
edges.note: inferred from De Magistro / the doctrine of divine illumination; consistent with Augustine's grounded edges but not filed on this gap.

edges.fill: The guarantee rests on prior gratuitous election because the co-working good is not owed to the lovers' love but flows from the God who first named them — the leap IS the priority of grace.
edges.note: inferred; consistent with Augustine's grounded edges but not filed on this specific edge-gap in the run.

edges.fill: The 'set' foreknown is the class of foreseen believers, not an absolute decree; the guarantee rests on God's foreknowledge of faith, so the leap is to prescience, not election.
edges.note: inferred; consistent with Arminius's grounded reframes but not filed on this specific edge-gap in the run.

edges.fill: There is no unwarranted leap: providence for the lovers-of-God is only the visible face of election; the guarantee rests on foreknowing precisely because foreknowing IS God's electing love from eternity.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.21-24; makes the edge a seam within one decree rather than a jump between two orders.

edges.fill: The guarantee rests on foreknowing only as prescience — God, foreseeing who would love Him, ordered all things to their good; the leap is to honour foreseen willingness, not to impose a decree.
edges.note: inferred from Homilies on Romans (Hom. 15); the non-deterministic reading of the same edge.

edges.fill: The foreknowing is not the selection of a set but God's eternal self-determination to be for humanity in Christ; the guarantee rests on that Yes, so the 'leap' dissolves into one act of grace.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; dissolves rather than bridges the edge.

edges.fill: The inward experience of glory is the beatific vision — 'we shall rest and see, see and love, love and praise'; the restless heart at last at rest in God, the eternal Sabbath of the City.
edges.note: inferred from De civitate Dei 22.30 + Confessiones 1.1; the classic Latin phenomenology of glory. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: Glory felt from inside is deification consummated — the creature, without ceasing to be creature, wholly participant in the Word's incorruption; seeing God and being remade by the seeing.
edges.note: inferred from De Incarnatione; the Greek interior of glory as completed theosis.

edges.fill: Glory is perfect love brought to its consummation — the love that began as a strangely-warmed heart now filling the whole soul without remainder, sin's last root gone.
edges.note: inferred from 'Christian Perfection'; glory as the telos of the sanctification Wesley traces experientially.

edges.fill: The aorist is secured by the perseverance of the saints: because glorification hangs on the same immutable decree as election, Paul can speak of it as already done — God's counsel cannot fail.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.24; the decree-grounded reading of the past-tense-for-future.

edges.fill: The aorist is secured by the donum perseverantiae — perseverance to glory is itself a gift God grants the elect, so their glorification is as certain as the grace that carries them there.
edges.note: inferred from De dono perseverantiae; the gift-of-perseverance ground for the settled past tense.

edges.fill: The aorist expresses the certainty of God's OFFER and purpose, not an unconditional roster — the promise is sure, but a believer may forfeit it; assurance is present, Spirit-witnessed, and holds while faith holds.
edges.note: inferred from 'The Witness of the Spirit' + the Notes on Rom 8; recasts the security as conditional-yet-really-assured — the sharpest rival to Calvin/Augustine on this gap.

edges.fill: The aorist is secured because glorification is already accomplished in Christ the elect human; it is spoken in the past tense because in Him it is a finished fact, not a probability awaiting individuals.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; the Christological ground for the past tense.

edges.fill: The call reaches its addressees by TWO means: the outward call of the preached Word offered to all, and the inward effectual call of the Spirit that alone makes it take — only the second infallibly reaches the elect.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.24; the external/internal calling distinction is purpose-built to answer this gap. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: By the viva vox evangelii — the living voice of the gospel preached; faith comes by hearing, and the external Word is the appointed means through which the Spirit works, never apart from it.
edges.note: inferred from the Romans lectures + Luther's theology of the Word as means of grace.

edges.fill: The call reaches all by prevenient grace working through the preached word and the awakened conscience — a genuine, resistible summons offered universally, not restricted to a secret inner elect.
edges.note: inferred from 'The Scripture Way of Salvation'; recasts the means as universally-offered.

edges.fill: Being justified is felt as the terrified conscience finding peace — the accusing law silenced, the joyous exchange in which Christ takes the sin and gives His righteousness; sudden release from despair into safety.
edges.note: inferred from the Romans lectures + the 'tower experience'; Luther's whole interior life is this gap. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: Felt as Aldersgate — 'my heart was strangely warmed; I did trust in Christ, Christ alone, for salvation; and an assurance was given me that He had taken away my sins.'
edges.note: inferred from Wesley's Journal (24 May 1738); the paradigmatic felt-account of being-declared-right.

edges.fill: Felt as the restless heart coming to rest — the long division of the will healed, the conscience that fled itself now able to stand, because the righteousness is God's and not its own.
edges.note: inferred from Confessiones 8-9; the interior of justification as the will's reunification.

edges.fill: Glorification is accomplished by the lumen gloriae — a created light infused into the intellect that elevates it to see the divine essence; the beatific vision the natural intellect could never reach unaided.
edges.note: inferred from ST I q.12 + Suppl.; the precise scholastic instrument of glory. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: Glorification is accomplished by deification — the Word's assumption of flesh communicating incorruption to the whole nature; not a light added to the mind but the creature remade in the Son's own life.
edges.note: inferred from De Incarnatione; recasts the means from cognitive elevation to ontological participation.

edges.fill: By union with the risen Christ — glorification is the completion of the ingrafting into Him, the resurrection of the body and the full conforming to His glorious likeness the Spirit has been working toward.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.25; glory as the terminus of union.

edges.fill: 'Those' are the elect — drawn out of the massa damnata by gratuitous choice; the set is defined by God's election alone, not by any foreseen quality in them.
edges.note: inferred from Ad Simplicianum; the Augustinian filling of the underdetermined substrate. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: 'Those' are the class of foreseen believers — the set is defined by faith God foreknew, so it is a real, open class constituted by response, not a closed roster fixed by decree.
edges.note: inferred; the synergist reading of the substrate slot.

edges.fill: 'Those' are those chosen in Christ before the foundation of the world; the substrate is filled by eternal election, and every later link (call, justify, glorify) is only its unfolding.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.21; the elect-roster reading.

edges.fill: 'Those' is not a set of individuals at all — it is Christ the elect human and, in Him, all humanity; the underdetermined slot is filled Christologically, dissolving the roster question.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; the modern dissolution of the substrate. THIS gap is the keystone — every camp answers it and none closes it (see 'refuses-to-close' finding).

edges.fill: The conforming is accomplished by grace infused through instrumental causes — the sacraments as channels of grace, the infused theological virtues, and the gifts of the Spirit reshaping the soul to the Son's likeness.
edges.note: inferred from ST III (sacraments as instrumental causes) + I-II q.62; directly answers the 'sacraments?' branch of the gap. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: By mortification and vivification through union with Christ — the Spirit daily putting the old nature to death and raising the new, the cross borne in fellowship with the Son's sufferings.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.3, III.8; conformity by Spirit-wrought mortification, not sacramental infusion.

edges.fill: By the Spirit's sanctifying work through the means of grace — prayer, Scripture, the Supper, Christian fellowship — carrying the believer on toward perfect love; a real, felt, cooperative growth.
edges.note: inferred from 'The Means of Grace' + 'Christian Perfection'; conformity as progressive sanctification.

edges.fill: Being-called is felt as 'Tolle, lege' — a voice heard as if a child's, the sudden inward turning, years of resistance collapsing in a moment: 'late have I loved Thee, Beauty so ancient and so new.'
edges.note: inferred from Confessiones 8.12; the paradigmatic felt-account of the call. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: Being-called is felt first as prevenient grace — an inward drawing, a dissatisfaction and a longing awakened before any decision — then as the heart strangely warmed when the call is answered.
edges.note: inferred from the Journal + 'The Witness of the Spirit'; the call felt as gradual awakening then sudden assurance.

edges.fill: Glory is full for each but GRADED — all the blessed see the divine essence, yet each sees more or less clearly in proportion to charity; the vision never comprehends God, so fullness is real but never exhausts its object.
edges.note: inferred from ST I q.12 a.6; Aquinas explicitly calibrates the degree the text leaves open — but even his answer reserves an eschatological remainder (see partial-close note). NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: Glory is as full as a creature can bear — total participation in the Son's incorruption, 'that man might become god'; the fullness is bounded only by the creature/Creator distinction the deification never erases.
edges.note: inferred from De Incarnatione; theosis as maximal-yet-creaturely fullness. This gap stays PARTIALLY open — no camp claims the fullness is exhaustively knowable now.

edges.fill: The shared knowing is held by the testimonium Spiritus Sancti internum — the same inward testimony of the Spirit by which we know Scripture is God's Word seals this assurance in the heart.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes I.7; Calvin's category for self-authenticating religious knowing. GAP FLAGGED THIN — this is Calvin extended, a decent but not decisive fit.

edges.fill: The knowing is held by faith — an infused habit assenting to first Truth on God's own authority, handed on through the Church's teaching; not private experience but a supernatural virtue.
edges.note: inferred from ST II-II q.1-2; the infused-faith account. GAP FLAGGED THIN.

edges.fill: The knowing is held experientially — the direct and indirect witness of the Spirit, confirmed by the fruits; a knowledge felt in the heart, not merely reasoned or received on authority.
edges.note: inferred from 'The Witness of the Spirit'; the experiential answer. GAP FLAGGED THIN — the modern epistemological form of 'how is the knowing held' has no strong single answerer; these three fan out without one clearly closing it.

edges.fill: He must be prototokos because 'firstborn' names not a creature among creatures but the Word through and into whom the many are re-created — firstborn of the dead, Head of the new humanity that shares His sonship.
edges.note: inferred from Orations against the Arians 2; Athanasius' anti-Arian exegesis of prototokos is exactly this gap's answer. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: 'Firstborn' signifies preeminence and headship — Christ as caput of the mystical body who holds the inheritance and communicates it to the brethren; the firstborn is the principle of the family's grace.
edges.note: inferred from Super Rom c.8 + ST III q.8; Christ as Head.

edges.fill: Grammatically, prototokos here carries both temporal priority (firstborn from the dead in resurrection) and rank/dignity (the honoured Head of the eschatological family), not mere seniority.
edges.note: inferred from ICC Romans on 8:29. §3 IN-COPYRIGHT — name-persona/proxy only; flagged for careful sourcing, do not quote as attested.

edges.fill: 'All things' means literally all — etiam peccata: even the sins of the elect are turned by providence to their good; God brings good out of every evil, so the scope is total, not selective.
edges.note: inferred from the Enchiridion + De correptione; Augustine's 'even sins' is the precise calibration the gap asks for. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: 'All things' is exhaustive because providence is meticulous — not bare foreknowledge but God's active governance of every single event; nothing falls outside it, so all co-works for the elect's good.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes I.16-18; the meticulous-providence calibration of 'all'.

edges.fill: Divine providence extends to all particulars; God permits even evils in order to draw from them a greater good, so 'all things' co-work by the ordering of the First Cause who governs all.
edges.note: inferred from ST I q.22; the scope calibrated by universal providence.
